segments.name: Financial communications services
segments.description: Provides financial printing, translation, production and related communications services to listed companies and listing applicants in Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: We operate in a single business line, being the provision of financial communications services and related support services in Hong Kong, and our chief operating decision maker reviews financial information on an aggregated basis.

revenueModel.text: Clients, mainly Hong Kong listed companies and listing applicants, pay the company for financial printing, translation, production, consultancy and related compliance support services under fixed-fee contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: consideration is generally fixed and agreed at the outset of each engagement.

changes.text: In 2025, the company acquired Miracle Media Production Limited, adding printing, translation, production and maintenance services.
changes.evidence: Completion of the acquisition took place on February 28, 2025. Following the acquisition, Miracle Media became our wholly owned subsidiary.
